notes.title: New build pushed coinciding with release of sequel "TAAM: Bring the Thunder"
notes.content: [p]A new build for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst"]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url] has just been set live to coincide with the release of the next game in the series [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder"]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url] (just released right now).[/p][p][/p][p]This new build of TAAM: DYW fixes a few bugs and updates the call-to-action at end of game to [b]purchase[/b] the next game of TAAM: BTT (as opposed to [b]wishlisting[/b] the next game, which was the previous call-to-action).[/p][p][/p][p]Although each game in the [b][i]There's Always a Madman[/i][/b] series is a standalone adventure for secret agents Franklin Benjamin and Virginia West, all three released games are on discount right now for the [b]Steam Summer Sale.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]With the release of the third entry, now is the best time to catch up on the entire series (with all three released games currently on discount).  And the fourth and fifth entries are available to wishlist on Steam now as well![/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372850/Theres_Always_a_Madman_The_MacGuffin" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: The MacGuffin[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373580/Theres_Always_a_Madman_VICTOR" style="button"]There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.[/url][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Best of luck agent - [b]because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got![/b][/p]

notes.title: Game on discount as part of Spy Video Game Rendezvous festival
notes.content:
Going on now - the first-ever Steam festival (and accompanying Direct) for spy video games, the [b]Spy Video Game Rendezvous[/b], includes all the games in the [b]There's Always a Madman[/b] series.
[list]
[*] Spy Video Game Rendezvous Direct: [url=https://youtu.be/OmzdWLCbzpE]https://youtu.be/OmzdWLCbzpE[/url]
[*] Spy Video Game Rendezvous Festival: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45263338/sale/SpyVideoGameRendezvous]https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45263338/sale/SpyVideoGameRendezvous[/url]
[/list]
Each of the two released games in the [b]There's Always a Madman[/b] series are on discount for the festival:
[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url]
[/list]
[b]Also announced as part of the festival:[/b] the third entry in the series, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282050/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Bring_the_Thunder]There's Always a Madman: Bring the Thunder[/url], will be releasing July 7th 2025[b][/b].  That's right - Agent 707 returns on 7/7, and there's a [b]free demo for the game you can play right now[/b] ahead of the June Steam Next Fest.

As you can tell, there's no better time to see if you have the secret agent skills necessary to save the world with two games on discount and another right around the corner (with a free demo of the third game that you can play now).  [b]Because there's always a madman, and you're the best agent we've got![/b]

notes.title: "There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst" is now available for sale!
notes.content:
In case you missed it - the comedic spy thriller interactive novel [url=url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url] is [b]now available for sale[/b]!

You can pick up the [b]standalone game[/b], the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] (with soundtrack), or even a [b]bundle with the first game[/b] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/url]).

I hope you enjoy the game!  While the first entry centered on secret agent Franklin Benjamin, this new game shifts the focus to his partner Virginia West.  While it can be considered a sequel to the first game, I designed it to work as a standalone entry.  This time out, secret agent Virginia West is tasked with stopping a madman known as The Silver Fox - [b]do you have what it takes to stop a silver-obsessed madman bent on destroying the Golden Gate Bridge?[/b]  Find out in the comedic spy thriller interactive novel ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/url]).

And of course, please be sure to [b]leave a review[/b] if you pick up the game and give it a play.  Whether positive or negative, any review lets others know about the game.  Plus, if reaching the ten-review threshold, then the game gets an official user rating (e.g. positive, neutral, negative) and simply having a user rating - whatever that rating is - can [b]boost the game's visibility[/b].

notes.title: Play the demo. Review the demo
notes.content:
The interactive spy novel [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/b][/i] now has a free demo that you can write a review for.  You can play the demo, then leave a review right here on the newly launched demo store page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo[/url]

[h2]About the Game and Demo[/h2]
[i][b]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/b][/i] is a single-player spy thriller interactive novel.  With a silver-loving madman bent on destroying the Golden Gate Bridge, it falls to you as secret agent Virginia West to stop him and save this iconic landmark.  When this much is at stake, [b]don’t do your best, agent … do your worst![/b]

The free demo provides four of the eleven chapters from the full game, ahead of the game's launch in Q4 2024.

[h2]Where to Find More from "There's Always a Madman"[/h2]

[b]Wishlist the full game[/b] and [b]play the free demo[/b] for [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Do Your Worst[/b][/i] right now right here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960910/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst_Demo[/url]

The store page of the full game is here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960890/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Do_Your_Worst[/url]

Don't forget to leave a review for the demo, now that it's possible to do so for select demos on Steam!

And if the demo leaves you in the mood to play more, then I have good news: the first game in the series [i][b]There's Always a Madman: Fight or Flight[/b][/i] focusing on secret agent Franklin Benjamin is available for purchase on Steam here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2390500/Theres_Always_a_Madman_Fight_or_Flight[/url]
